purpose: Bundled decorative editorial illustrations for ThorShelf's shelf and download thumbnails; not official covers or gameplay screenshots.

assets.name: shelf_hero
assets.prompt: Create a beautiful original game-inspired illustration as a wide 2.5:1 banner for a cozy handheld game library. Warm sunset tropical island panorama and a magnificent ruby red armored fantasy dragon on the right third, turquoise sea and lush green islands below. Left half fades to pale ivory peach with minimal soft clouds, intentionally empty for UI text. Modern polished colorful painted game art, playful and adventurous. No words, no logos, no interface or border. The dragon is a friendly fantastical original creature.

assets.name: shelf_animal_crossing
assets.prompt: Create a square original illustration for a cozy village game tile in a handheld library. A cheerful friendly yellow dog village secretary wearing a green checked vest smiles in a beautiful sunny garden. Tiny quaint pastel houses, blooming pink flowers, grassy hills, fruit trees, and soft blue sky. Warm polished colorful toy-like illustration with expressive friendly eyes. Fill the frame, no words, no letters, no logos, no interface, no border.

assets.name: shelf_mario_kart
assets.prompt: Square polished colorful illustration of a bright red racing go-kart on a sunny whimsical kart track. No driver or people: just a beautiful toy-like red kart with black tires and chrome details in the foreground, curved red-and-white race curb, lush green hills and a bright blue sky with puffy white clouds behind. Joyful premium family racing-game aesthetic, saturated red blue and green, expressive dynamic camera angle. No logos, words, numbers, interface, border, or watermarks. This will be a small decorative racing category image in a game library.
